coverage.agentCallableTools: All ToolDefinition registered in kernel ToolRegistry
coverage.withExplicitPermissionRequirement: All Tools declare Permissions in ToolDefinition.Permissions
coverage.explicitNoPermissionRequired: Tools with empty Permissions + RiskLevel=low get PermissionAllow (no broker requirement)

mechanism: PermissionGate.evaluateWithBroker: buildRequirements(tool, scope) 为空 → PermissionAllow; 否则必须经过 Broker.Evaluate
failClosed: Empty requirements = No permission needed (valid); Unknown permission ID = Deny
